meta.scope: Mexico batch 3 — short-term activity indicators, household income/expenditure, state & municipal public finances (EFIPEM), and Banco de México policy rate. Continues coverage across national / state / municipal and central-bank levels under the new broader node definition.

candidates.title: Indicador Global de la Actividad Económica (IGAE) / Global Indicator of Economic Activity
candidates.description: Monthly short-term indicator of overall economic activity, conceptually aligned with the production-side GDP of the SCNM. Part of the suite of short-term economic indicators published by INEGI.
candidates.notes: Key monthly bridge between high-frequency activity and the quarterly/annual national accounts. Listed among INEGI’s core economic information programmes alongside IMAI, IMAIEF, etc.

candidates.title: Indicador Mensual de la Actividad Industrial (IMAI) / Monthly Industrial Activity Indicator
candidates.description: Monthly indicator of industrial activity (mining, manufacturing, construction, electricity/gas/water). Base year 2018. Preliminary figures published according to the INEGI calendar.
candidates.notes: High-frequency industrial series. Companion state-level series IMAIEF (Indicador Mensual de la Actividad Industrial por Entidad Federativa) also exists and is published by INEGI.

candidates.title: Encuesta Nacional de Ingresos y Gastos de los Hogares (ENIGH) / National Survey of Household Income and Expenditure
candidates.description: Household income and expenditure survey. Primary source for the structure of household consumption used in CPI basket and weight updates (most recent major INPC update 2024 drew on Seasonal ENIGH 2022). Also central for poverty and distribution analysis.
candidates.notes: Direct documented input into the 2024 INPC basket and weights update. Contextual link from INEGI INPC documentation: the update of the Basket and Structure of weighting of the Consumer Price Index was based on information of the Seasonal ENIGH 2022, maintaining the base while applying chaining methodology.

candidates.title: Estadística de Finanzas Públicas Estatales y Municipales (EFIPEM) / State and Municipal Public Finances Statistics
candidates.description: Annual (and now also quarterly for states) statistics of revenues and expenditures of state governments, the government of Mexico City, municipalities and alcaldías. Provides the principal comparable picture of sub-national public finances. Geographic coverage: 32 entities + municipalities/alcaldías. Time series from the late 1980s/1990s onward with methodological synthesis documents.
candidates.notes:
Critical bridge node for state and municipal jurisdiction levels. INEGI aggregates and standardises the data; the underlying reporting comes from the entities themselves.

From INEGI programme description: "Información referente a los ingresos y egresos anuales de los Gobiernos de Estados, Municipios, Ciudad de México y Alcaldías con el fin de mostrar su comportamiento en el ámbito económico y social, contribuyendo a la transparencia de la acción pública..."

A Síntesis Metodológica is published (e.g. EFIPEM 2025 / 2026 edition covering 2024 data). From March 2026 INEGI also began publishing quarterly state public-finance figures (EFIPET) using internationally recommended classifications.

This series is the practical way most sub-national fiscal data enter the national statistical system and downstream analyses.

candidates.title: Objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día (Tasa Objetivo) / Overnight Interbank Funding Rate Target
candidates.description: Primary monetary-policy instrument of Banco de México. The Governing Board announces the target for the overnight interbank funding rate according to a published calendar of monetary-policy decisions. Decisions are published as press releases; minutes follow later. The rate is the main operational target used to influence the yield curve, exchange rate and inflation expectations.
candidates.notes:
Central-bank policy rate. Published on a pre-announced calendar (typically eight decisions per year). Recent examples (2026): decisions keeping the target at 6.50 % (August, June) or adjusting it by 25 bp steps earlier in the easing cycle.

Contextual quote from a typical announcement (5 Feb 2026 style):
"La Junta de Gobierno del Banco de México decidió mantener el objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día en 7.00%. ... Así, la Junta de Gobierno, con la presencia de todos sus miembros, decidió por unanimidad mantener el objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día en 7.00%."

The rate is referenced throughout Banxico quarterly reports and is the instrument through which monetary policy is described as transmitting to the real economy and prices.

candidates.title: Informe Trimestral / Quarterly Report (Banco de México)
candidates.description: Quarterly report of Banco de México on inflation, economic activity, monetary policy and the outlook. Published according to a fixed calendar. Contains the Board’s assessment of the inflationary environment and the rationale for the policy-rate path.
candidates.notes: Regular analytical publication that both uses and interprets INEGI price and activity data and explains the setting of the tasa objetivo. Full text, summary and presentation are released together. Serves as a documented link between Banxico’s policy rate and the broader statistical system (INEGI CPI, activity indicators, etc.).

candidates.title: Balanza Comercial de Mercancías de México / Merchandise Trade Balance
candidates.description: Monthly merchandise trade balance statistics. Methodological synthesis documents are published. Forms part of the external-sector information used in balance-of-payments and national-accounts work.
candidates.notes: High-frequency trade series. Síntesis metodológica documents exist (e.g. 2026 edition). Used as an input into broader external and national-accounts frameworks; Banxico and other users routinely cite the merchandise trade figures.

proposed_edges.basis: 2024 basket and weights update of the INPC was based on Seasonal ENIGH 2022 information.
Quarterly reports systematically analyse and cite INEGI inflation figures (INPC) when assessing the inflationary outlook and justifying the policy-rate decision.
Monetary-policy announcements and the surrounding quarterly reports evaluate observed and expected inflation (INPC) as a central input to the rate decision.
proposed_edges.reference_period: at each policy meeting / continuous monitoring

proposed_edges.basis: Produced by INEGI within the SNIEG framework as Information of National Interest / regular statistical programme under the LSNIEG.
